_about: Each resort's PLANNED 2026/27 season dates, recorded on 4 Nov 2026 before the season began, so the actual first open day (from snapshots) can be compared with what was announced: did the strong El Nino autumn delay the start? Dates come from secondary roundups (cited per resort), not resort press releases, and were all described as weather-dependent. 'early' is a glacier or partial opening ahead of the main one; 'open' is the main winter opening. Never edit these after the fact: if a resort moves its date, add 'revised' with the new date and the day it was seen.

cervinia.notes: 24 Oct is Plateau Rosa glacier; 28 Nov is Valtournenche (same consortium). Close given as 2 or 5 May on the same official page.

zermatt.notes: Glacier Paradise skis almost all year; 1 Nov starts 'Winter Opening Weeks'; Sunnegga and Gornergrat ~28 Nov. Other roundups said 24 Oct.

val-thorens.notes: Val Thorens-Orelle; wider 3 Vallees links from 5 Dec.

courchevel.notes: Village, Moriond and La Tania from 5 Dec.

tignes.notes: Progressive opening; Tignes-Val d'Isere link from 28 Nov.

alpe-dhuez.notes: Oz and Vaujany may open sector by sector.

les-deux-alpes.notes: Possible short glacier opening at Toussaint (alpy only).

chamonix.notes: Grands Montets (and Flegere per guide-ski) 28 Nov; Brevent and Balme 12 Dec; whole valley 19 Dec.

verbier.notes: Sources disagree: 31 Oct, 14 Nov and 5 Dec all cited. 4 Vallees link ~2 weeks after.

saas-fee.notes: Alpin Express to the glacier, Fri-Sun at first, then daily. No main-season date given.

engelberg.notes: Titlis glacier; the source itself says the date could not be confirmed.

soelden.notes: Rettenbach glacier hosts the World Cup 24-25 Oct (glacier skiing usually from late Sep); main area date is the source's estimate.

hintertux.notes: Glacier runs almost all year; 4 Dec is the valley lifts.

monterosa.notes: Champoluc, Staffal, Gressoney-La-Trinite and Alagna 28 Nov; Brusson, Antagnod and Gressoney-Saint-Jean weekends from 5 Dec, daily from 19 Dec.

passo-tonale.notes: Unconfirmed: funivie says no date announced.

st-moritz.notes: Corviglia 28 Nov if snow allows; some sources say 21 Nov for St. Moritz.

obergurgl.notes: Source said the official date was not yet published.

baqueira-beret.notes: Third-party only; no official page found.
